expertise-card.$description: A case study's scope facts. They run longer than the home's one-word skills, so the columns size to content and wrap (auto-fit, a static in resolver.json) rather than cramming into fixed tracks where a long value overflows its neighbour.

padding-inline.$description: No fixed inset here: the columns are content-sized and auto-fit, and an inset on top of that would fight the wrap they depend on. The width static narrows the grid instead.

margin-bottom.$description: Double the gap a value's own margin sets, so the title sits further from its sub text without widening the gaps between values.
